pitfalls: Do not enable config after creating disabled DAG without separately initializing required storage.
Do not mutate ExportFile config while borrowed by TcCtx.
A disabled control must say whether it gates retained real literal inputs or only a syntactic application; constructor None equality is not an adequate positive control.
Explicit name-cache bindings test name-to-operation mapping, not automatic discovery of Nat names.
Assert expected payloads rather than comparing native helper outputs to themselves.
Name pointers allocated in a temporary context cannot silently outlive its storage.
Keep global name-cache fields distinct; unrelated prior operation entries may be None because dispatcher compares Some(name)==field without early ? bailout.
